inputs.original_text: DHS announced that ICE arrested an illegal immigrant gang member after New York City authorities released him, despite his posing a danger to public safety. DHS criticized the city’s actions, saying the case highlights tensions between sanctuary policies and federal immigration enforcement and the potential public safety risks of releasing people with criminal records.
